content.text: All six preferred elements are present. Submitting compliant without a redline.

input.quote:
18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 18 meets the preferred insurance position in full: CGL at USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional E&O at USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5,000,000 (carried unconditionally, so the Customer Data condition is satisfied), workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates of insurance on request under § 18.2. Additional Customer-favourable terms (one-year tail, employer's liability, primary coverage, notice of cancellation, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities) exceed our ask. Additional-insured status is not required by the playbook and is a note only; no redline warranted.
